rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when “enjoy” means generally liking an activity or finding it pleasurable.

example.english: I enjoy listening to music after work.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 ji3 fong3 gung1 hau6 teng1 go1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone consciously takes pleasure or satisfaction in something.

example.traditional: 我最享受一個人飲咖啡嘅時間。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 hoeng2 sau6 jat1 go3 jan4 jam2 gaa3 fe1 ge3 si4 gaan3

rows.note: Use this for enjoying a holiday, outing, or other leisure activity, especially in wishes such as “have fun.”

example.jyutping: zuk1 nei5 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 wun2 dak1 hoi1 sam1
